name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A Notion-and-Miro-style notes-and-planning app you can run yourself, so your team's documents never have to live on someone else's cloud server.
buyer: A small law firm, healthcare practice, or any data-sensitive consultancy that wants Notion-like docs and planning but isn't allowed to put client data on a third-party cloud.
business_use_cases: An IT consultancy offers a paid 'self-hosted AFFiNE setup + migration from Notion' package for privacy-conscious small businesses and regulated-industry clients.
An agency white-labels self-hosted AFFiNE instances for clients in law, healthcare, or finance who are required to keep data on-premise or in a specific region.
A reseller bundles AFFiNE hosting plus team training for companies trying to cut their Notion/Miro subscription costs at scale.

money_ideas.idea: One-off migration and self-hosted setup project for a privacy-conscious small business
Managed hosting subscription for clients who want the self-hosted benefits without running their own servers

steal_this: Offer local law and healthcare offices a 'bring your Notion in-house' migration package this month, pricing it against what they'd pay a cloud SaaS over two years.
